mapper.select: select TPD.TRADE_ID tradeId, TPDA.ENTRUST_ID entrustId, PP.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, PP.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, TPDA.EXC_DEAL_TYPE excDealType, TPDA.CUR_PAIR curPair, FTP.EXC_PS ps, TPD.DELIVERY_TYPE deliveryType, TPD.TRADE_DATE tradeDate, FTP.TERM_TYPE termType, ftp.HOLD_PURPOSE holdPurpose, /*持有目的*/ FTP.MDATE settleDate, TPD.UNIT_CPRICE unitCprice, TPD.UNIT_INT unitInt, TPD.UNIT_FPRICE unitFprice, TPDA.PRICED_DATE pricedDate, TPDA1.TRADE_ID tradeId1, TPDA1.PRICED_DATE_RATE pricedDateRate, TPDA1.DIF_PS difPs, TPDA1.DIF_PAY_AMT difPayAmt, FTP.CCY ccy, TPD.PRIN_AMT prinAmt, TPD.CCY corCcy, TPD.FPRICE_AMT fpriceAmt, TPDA.USD_AMT usdAmt, TPD.REMARK remark, FTP.CALENDAR_ID calendarId, TPDA.OUR_ROLE ourRole, TPDA.DEAL_MODE dealMode, TPD.INV_AIM invAim, TPD.FEE_AMT feeAmt, TPD.TRADER trader, TPD.COUNTER_ID, TPD.COUNTER_TRADER, TPD.COUNTER_CONTACT, SFPA1.ACCT_NO dealAcct, SFPA2.ACCT_NO corAcct, TPDA.REF_RATE refRate, DECODE(TPD1.PS,#{PS_T07}, DECODE(TPD.DELIVERY_TYPE,#{SETTMODE_DIF_SETT},#{YES_NO_YES},null),null) isDifSquEx from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TPD left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD TPDA on TPD.TRADE_ID = TPDA.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_TRADE PT ON nvl(TPD.P_TRADE_ID, TPD.TRADE_ID) = PT.BUSI_NO left join PTL_PORTFOLIO PP on PP.PORTFOLIO_ID = PT.PORTFOLIO_ID left join FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT FTP on FTP.FINPROD_ID = TPD.FINPROD_ID left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TPD1 on FTP.FINPROD_ID = TPD1.FINPROD_ID and TPD1.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F12} and TPD1.PS = #{PS_T07} and TPD.TRADE_STATUS = TPD1.TRADE_STATUS left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD TPDA1 on TPD1.TRADE_ID = TPDA1.TRADE_ID left join STL_FIN_PRODUCT_ACCT SFPA1 ON SFPA1.FINPROD_ID = TPD.FINPROD_ID AND SFPA1.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F12} AND SFPA1.ACCT_TYPE = #{ASSET_ACCT_TYPE_01} left join STL_FIN_PRODUCT_ACCT SFPA2 ON SFPA2.FINPROD_ID = TPD.FINPROD_ID AND SFPA2.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F12} AND SFPA2.ACCT_TYPE = #{ASSET_ACCT_TYPE_02} WHERE TPD.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F12} and TPD.PS = #{PS_T01} and TPD.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} AND PP.INVEST_YESORNO='Y'

SELECT EE.ENTRUST_ID entrustId, EE.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, EEA.EXC_DEAL_TYPE excDealType, EEA.CUR_PAIR curPair, EE.PS ps, EEA.TERM_TYPE termType, EE.INV_AIM invAim, EE.CCY ccy, EEA.COR_CCY corCcy, decode(EEA.IS_DIF_SQU,'Y',EEA.CNY_ACCT,EEA.DEAL_CUR_ACCT) dealAcct, EEA.COR_CUR_ACCT corAcct, EE.COUNTER_ID, EE.COUNTER_TRADER, EE.CONTACT_INFO COUNTER_CONTACT, EE.ENTRUST_AMT-NVL(FINISH_AMT,0) nDealCurAmt, EE.PRICE unitFprice, EEA.EXP_COR_AMT corAmt, ED.TRADER, EEA.IS_DIF_SQU isDifSqu, EE.ENTRUST_AMT-NVL(FINISH_AMT,0) prinAmt, EEA.EXP_COR_AMT fpriceAmt FROM ETR_ENTRUST EE LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST_ADD EEA ON EE.ENTRUST_ID = EEA.ENTRUST_ID LEFT JOIN ETR_DISTRIBUTE ED ON ED.ENTRUST_ID = EE.ENTRUST_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT ENTRUST_ID, SUM(FINISH_AMT) FINISH_AMT FROM ETR_FINISH_STATUS GROUP BY ENTRUST_ID) FINISH_AMT ON FINISH_AMT.ENTRUST_ID = EE.ENTRUST_ID
EE.ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
